_comment: Tier-2 for dealii nonlinear#0. Tier-2 for dealii nonlinear#0 -- probe "cold_start" of the shared translation unit _shared/nonlinear_family.cc, compiled once and cached so every fixture that names a probe of that unit shares ONE C++ build. Minimal surface equation (step-15's problem) on the unit square with boundary data of amplitude 8. Three starting points are run in every invocation: the literal all-zero vector, the same zero interior WITH the boundary values interpolated onto it, and a five-step continuation. Every Newton loop here uses a backtracking line search, so what is being isolated is the initial guess and nothing else. Mutation control: T2_MUTATE=1 makes the probe run the CORRECT variant, and the fixture then fails its own expectations. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against deal.II 9.8.0-pre (Release at ~/dealii/build; Debug at the dbgbuild tree where the fixture sets requires_debug); every expect_in_output string was copied from that run.
